correctness.rationale: Checked odd fourth powers =1+16 Z_2 and odd sixth powers =1+8 Z_2 from unit-group/Hensel lifting. Comparing valuations 4a and 6b gives equal 12k and near-ties at differences ±2, while differences ≥4 are absorbed in pure-power cosets; the cases constructively give precisely seven disjoint balls at scales 2^(12k). Their seven measures sum to 1073/4096; divide by 1-2^-12. Independent direct residue enumeration and separate ball reduction agree for every modulus 2^n, 1<=n<=13. The infinite conclusion comes from exact valuation/exhaustion and compactness, not extrapolated finite tests.
